description.p: A native GTK client for Papo community servers, with text messages, direct messages, media, voice calls, camera and screen sharing.
Embed application control icons for consistent rendering across desktop themes in AppImage and Flatpak packages.
Use backend-provided video dimensions, improve legacy video attachment recognition, and keep unsupported containers available as downloads.
Voice-channel text chat, improved media caching and rendering, updated backend integration, and modern Linux packages.
